title_sq: Apartament 3+1+2 ne shitje te Restorant 2 Luanet, DAJT 141,000 EURO
description_sq:
Apartament 3+1 ne shitje ne rrugen Dajti prane Restorant 2 Luanet ne Tirane.
Ndodhet ne katin e katert te nje pallati te ri ne proces instalimi te ashensorit.
Ofron siperfaqe totale prej 131.2 m2 dhe te brendshme prej 115 m2 qe organizohet ne sallon sebashku me kuzhinen, 3 dhoma gjumi, korridor, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone.
Orientim apartamenti eshte Jug-Lindja qe i jep drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites.
Ka akses te shpejte me rrugen Muhemt Deliu, zonen e Shkozes, Unazen e Madhe dhe zonen e Linzes.
Prona eshte e pajisur me certifikate pronesie.
Cmimi: 141.000 euro
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale at Restaurant 2 Luanet, DAJT 141,000 EURO
description_en: 3+1 apartment for sale on Dajti street near Restaurant 2 Luanet in Tirana. It is located on the fourth floor of a new building in the process of installing the elevator. It offers a total surface of 131.2 m2 and an interior of 115 m2, which is organized in the living room together with the kitchen, 3 bedrooms, corridor, 2 toilets and 2 balconies. The orientation of the apartment is South-East, which provides natural light throughout the day. There is quick access to Muhemt Deliu street, the area of ​​Shkoza, the Great Ring and the area of ​​Linze. The property is equipped with ownership certificates. Price: 141,000 euros
